description: Returns historical NetBox events for an optional event name/date range (wraps NBAPI GetEventHistory).

ENDDTTM.description: Optional. End of the date/time range to query (NBAPI-documented format).

EVENTNAME.description: Optional. Restrict results to this event name.

NEXTKEY.description: Optional. Pagination continuation cursor from a previous call.

STARTDTTM.description: Optional. Start of the date/time range to query (NBAPI-documented format).

name: get_event_history
